findings.finding: Both quotations resolve. The source supports persona-induced ingroup favouritism and outgroup bias, Likert-anchored political and gender experiments, and reassignment to the initially disfavoured identity as a tested prompt-level mitigation.

Generative_KI, Prompting, Bias_Ungleichheit, Gender and Fairness are grounded in the explicit persona manipulation, measured group bias and debiasing comparison. Diversitaet is bounded to intergroup treatment, while the document correctly excludes Soziale_Arbeit.

The political/gender, English, United States, selected-model and binary-group limits agree with the source. Figures are not needed for the qualitative claims because the relevant effects and statistics are also reported in prose and linearised tables.
